import pandas as pd
d=[("East","Vienna",36483.879999999976),("North","Trondheim",24326.939999999988),("South","Oslo",26339.030000000002),("West","Lisbon",29471.18),("South","Naples",28128.550000000007),("North","Oslo",28939.53),("East","Prague",32254.819999999985),(None,None,515.47),("South","Rome",49802.31999999996),("North","Bergen",56068.28999999996),("West","Porto",19680.61000000001),(None,"Paris",677.83)]
df=pd.DataFrame(d,columns=["region","city","rev"])
df["rk"]=df.region.fillna("__")
df["share_region"]=df.rev/df.groupby("rk").rev.transform("sum")
df["share_total"]=df.rev/df.rev.sum()
df=df.sort_values(["rk","city"],na_position="first")
print(df.drop(columns="rk").to_json(orient="values"))

import json
print(json.dumps([[r.region,r.city,r.share_region,r.share_total] for r in df.itertuples()]))

d=[("East","Vienna",36483.879999999976),("North","Trondheim",24326.939999999988),("South","Oslo",26339.030000000002),("West","Lisbon",29471.18),("South","Naples",28128.550000000007),("North","Oslo",28939.53),("East","Prague",32254.819999999985),(None,None,515.47),("South","Rome",49802.31999999996),("North","Bergen",56068.28999999996),("West","Porto",19680.61000000001),(None,"Paris",677.83)]
df=pd.DataFrame(d,columns=["region","city","rev"])
df["rk"]=df.region.fillna("__")
df["sr"]=df.rev/df.groupby("rk").rev.transform("sum")
df["st"]=df.rev/df.rev.sum()

args.message: Revenue (the sum of order amounts) is split by each customer's region and city, with every order counted. The table shows each city's share of its region's revenue and its share of all revenue. Orders with no matching customer form the region-unknown, city-unknown group, which has $515.47 of revenue. Customers in Paris have no known region, so Paris ($677.83) and the unmatched orders together make up the region-unknown group. Oslo shows up under both North and South because customers there are assigned to different regions.
